summary: Playboy, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose amendments to a lease with RK Rivani LLC for office space in Miami Beach. The Amendment adjusts the delivery date to January 1, 2027, extends the lease to November 2037, abates rent/taxes from January to July 2027, and adds cross-default provisions. A new lease for the remaining floor space, effective May 1, 2026, includes abated rent through February 2027 with monthly rent starting at $49,840 in March 2027 and an irrevocable letter of credit requirement. This is a routine property lease, not a special situation.
